proofLimits: Two new record-inspection archive/source profiles. Closed evidence-review, file-review, hosting and older packets are not replayed.

React 19.2.8 and TypeScript 5.9.3, four installed RecordInspector/FieldConfidenceList SSR profiles and strict public types. Complete selected JSON/evidence and native confidence meters are inspected as supplied claims, not verified accuracy. No browser, modal claim, source verification, fetching, persistence, external MCP host, permission grant or model execution in this helper.
Seven locally generated archives are not public npm package-name installs. Fresh transitive locks are retained rather than equated with the workspace lock.
The outer supervisor owns namespace scanning and final scratch removal. This helper checks its direct children, streams and original process groups.
